title: A 4-Ounce Bird Flies 44,000 Miles Every Year

scenes.text: A four-ounce bird flies 44,000 miles every year.
It's the Arctic tern, and it flies from Greenland to Antarctica and back.
Scientists tracked 60 of them with trackers weighing just 1.4 grams. The longest trip was 50,700 miles.
Arctic terns often live 30 years or more.
Over a lifetime, that adds up to about 1.5 million miles.
Three trips to the Moon and back, on four ounces of bird.

description:
The Arctic tern flies about 44,000 miles a year, from Greenland to Antarctica and back.
The longest trip tracked was 50,700 miles.
Over a lifetime that is about three trips to the Moon and back.
Could you fly that far if you had wings?
